heroHeadline: Day 382: US SecState Rubio Acknowledges Pakistan Terrorism Sponsorship at Quad FM Meeting in New Delhi — India-US Partnership Reset Strengthens India's Diplomatic Posture
heroSubtitle: May 27, 2026: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio concluded his India visit on May 26 by attending the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi, where he explicitly acknowledged that Pakistan-sponsored terrorist groups operate from Pakistani soil — the clearest U.S. endorsement yet of India's core strategic justification for Operation Sindoor and the post-Pahalgam measures. Rubio assured EAM Jaishankar that US ties with Pakistan would not come at the expense of the US-India relationship, and invited PM Modi to the White House. For Pakistan, which had worked since May 2025 to rebuild U.S. goodwill, Rubio's statement is a diplomatic setback. The ceasefire holds at Day 382 with no LOC violations since May 10, 2025. India's airspace NOTAM expired May 24 without renewal; Pakistan's ban continues through June 23/24. The full bilateral freeze persists: no ambassadors, $0 formal trade, IWT suspended and legally contested following India's 'null and void' rejection of the PCA's May 15 award.
footerNote: Data sourced from Indian MEA/MOD, Pakistan ISPR/MFA, UN Security Council, SIPRI, Crisis Group, HRW, Stimson Center
